Hi. You didn't end up here by accident.
Your network infrastructure has been encrypted. We also downloaded data from your network and are currently analyzing it for an article to be published on our blog.
As soon as the file list is ready, we will send it to you immediately for review.
While negotiations are ongoing, only you can see the article. In case of prolonged silence, your company name and the article will be published on our blog. Files will be published automatically when the timer expires.
Before sending your first message, make sure to review the FAQ.
Return key:[redacted]
Without it, you will be unable to return to this chat.
Hello, let us know what files have you got?
Total downloaded info from your network 260gb. Soon we will send you a list of files that we have.
list_[redacted].txt
You can select 3-5 files, and we will provide them as proof.
We admit the attack. What's your  demand?

We are waiting for your proposal; we can only discuss a discount after you make a serious offer.
We are ready to pay $120K. Will that work?
Your proposal is rejected. However, we will offer you a discount - the amount due is $800,000.
We can't accept such huge figures. Maximum, we can stretch to $200K.
We are prepared to offer an additional discount. The amount due is $700,000.
Sorry, you need to understand our financial position. There are many inflated figures. However, our final offer would be $250K.
As we have mentioned, our final offer would be $250K.
We are declining your offer.Can we begin publishing your data if this is your final offer?
The maximum we can afford is $300K.
We will offer an additional discount. The total due is $600,000
Let's deal it for $500K. What say? As we have increased $200K which was beyond our budget.
The first transfer should be a test one, usually it's an amount up to $100. After we confirm the test transfer, you can send the remaining amount.
